user_message.content:
I want you to use this url as the design concept that my friend made.  I want to keep the overall feel and look of the webapp, but I want it to have the following functionality in the .zip file here I attaached here. I also attached exactly what robert is wanting the app to do as a .md file - He already did this entire process but that was before ai and he had to do everything by hand so he isn't doing something he isn't familiar with or with friends that haven't already participated.  
I want to replace the current pick'em app prototype in this project with the codebase in the attached zip (nfl-pickem-pool.zip). This is a complete, working backend + frontend — please swap it in entirely rather than merging it with the existing prototype's code. The old app's access-code links won't carry over; the new app uses phone-number sign-in instead.

What's in the zip:

- Node.js/Express API (server/)
- Postgres schema — 5 SQL migration files in sql/, must run in this exact order:
  schema.sql, 002_add_games.sql, 003_add_winner_payout.sql, 004_add_app_settings.sql, 005_add_background_photo.sql
- Plain HTML/JS/CSS frontend (public/), served by the same Express app — no separate build step
- A Dockerfile, ready to deploy as-is

Please:

1. Provision a Postgres database for this project (if one doesn't already exist) and run the 5 migrations above, in order.
2. Install the dependencies in package.json and deploy the app (use the Dockerfile, or run `node server/index.js` directly if you're not containerizing).
3. Set these environment variables — I'll give you the actual values separately, don't invent placeholders and treat them as final:
   - DATABASE_URL
   - JWT_SECRET
   - TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER
   - CRON_SECRET
   - ORGANIZER_ZELLE_HANDLE, ORGANIZER_CASHAPP_HANDLE
   - ORGANIZER_PERCENTAGE (defaults to 0.10 if omitted)
4. Once it's live, I'll sign in once through the app's own phone-code login. After that, run this against the database to make my account an admin:
   UPDATE users SET is_admin = true WHERE phone = '<my actual phone number>';
5. Set up two scheduled jobs hitting the app's own endpoints (exact routes and the required x-cron-secret header are documented in README.md, under "Wiring up the scheduled jobs"):
   - Score refresh — every 15-30 minutes during game windows
   - Deadline reminders — a few times before each week's lock

Read README.md in full before starting — it documents everything built, every required env var, and the couple of manual steps (the migrations and the first-admin promotion) that are deliberately not automated.

I'll upload the background photo myself through the app's own admin panel once it's live — nothing needed from you there.

Let me know if anything in the zip fails to run so we can sort it out before real cards start coming in.
